svg.text: One training step: control flow, batch growth, and weight handoff
Pinned at fbb4b3a8 · Read top → bottom. The driver owns orchestration and the DataProto; heavyweight model work is dispatched to Ray workers.
single controller · orders RPCs · owns and unions the batch
distributed generation, inference, and optimizer work
each row shows what is added; entries persist downward

g.text: DataLoader → DataProto; assign one uid per prompt; repeat × rollout.n.
uid is the grouping key later used by GRPO
rollout weight/KV-cache memory before training-side model work.
Agent loop sends requests to vLLM/SGLang servers; optional reward workers
can stream alongside rollout when enabled.
responses/generation tensors are unioned; rollout_log_probs may be present
If needed, ask RewardLoopManager for RM scores; extract_reward(batch)
combines the configured reward sources into reward_tensor on the driver.
compute_rm_score runs only when a reward model is used and rm_scores
were not already produced during the agent loop.
reward is materialized into token-level fields at step 6
Normally recompute once for this data batch. Bypass mode instead copies
Actor training model inference; entropy is reduced to metrics, then removed.
stable across the actor's mini-batch epochs
Dispatch after πold; union the returned reference-policy likelihoods.
ref_policy_wg · or actor WG with LoRA disabled
Only when use_critic; GRPO commonly omits this entire branch.
Distributed critic forward pass; driver converts output back to padding.
Materialize rewards + compute advantage on driver
scores ← reward_tensor; rewards ← scores or scores − β·KL(πold, πref).
Then compute_advantage(…) mutates this same DataProto.
Estimator fork · both are local tensor math
Driver repacks no-padding mini-batches and collects metrics.
Critic optimizer consumes returns/values and changes critic parameters.
the accumulated batch is consumed; metrics return separately
Driver sets PPO epochs/mini-batch metadata and dispatches the full payload.
actor.train_mini_batch performs policy optimization → new θt+1.
prompts + rollout + masks + old log-probs + ref*/values*
actor training engine θt+1 → rollout engine
Rollout wakes with θt+1 for the next step
fit() calls worker-group compute methods through RPC and performs the
lightweight advantage calculation locally. Model execution stays distributed.
Critic warmup skips actor update and only wakes rollout with unchanged weights.
The weights never stage on the driver
The manager holds actor_wg + rollout replica handles. Colocated “naive” sync
exports actor.engine tensors directly into self.rollout.update_weights.
Other backends pair actor send_weights with rollout receive/update workers.
A preload sync also runs once before the training loop begins.
What differs between PPO and GRPO?
PPO/GAE consumes critic values and computes token-wise TD advantages/returns.
GRPO repeats samples per prompt, groups summed rewards by uid, normalizes each
group, broadcasts to response tokens, and usually has no critic branch.
Optional in-reward KL requires old_log_probs + ref_log_prob.
